templates.label: GitHub
templates.description: Issue triage, PR review, repo housekeeping. Needs a GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope.

secret_prompts.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
secret_prompts.help_text: Fine-grained token, repo scope (read for triage; write to create issues/PRs).

templates.upstream_status_warning: @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is marked deprecated by upstream (npm warning at install). Still functional. M2 Month 2 candidate to switch to github.com/github/github-mcp-server (Go binary, official).

templates.label: Filesystem
templates.description: Bounded filesystem access (read/write within an explicit sandbox path). No credentials.

string_prompts.label: Sandbox directory path
string_prompts.help_text: Filesystem MCP can only touch paths under this directory. Use an explicit subdir, never your home root.

templates.validation_notes: Used as the canonical reference MCP in unit tests + cross-thread regression suite (test_ws_chat_mcp_integration.py).

templates.label: Slack (bring your own server)
templates.description: Connects dialekt to a Slack-aware HTTP MCP gateway YOU run. dialekt does NOT bundle a Slack MCP — pick a maintained one or run your own (e.g. an internal HTTP wrapper around the Slack Web API).

secret_prompts.label: Bearer token
secret_prompts.help_text: Your Slack MCP gateway's auth token, NOT a Slack bot token directly. The gateway handles Slack auth on its side.

templates.validation_notes: Slack MCP server quality varies. v0.21.0 ships this template as a starting point only — bring your own MCP server.

templates.label: Linear
templates.description: Issue tracking via a Linear MCP server. Community package — bring your own API key.

secret_prompts.label: Linear API key
secret_prompts.help_text: Personal API key from Linear settings → API → Create new key.

templates.validation_notes: Pinned to @hatcloud/linear-mcp@1.2.2 (latest as of 2026-04-25). Single-maintainer community package; no public source repo linked from npm metadata. Verify with [Test] before committing pilots.

templates.label: Notion
templates.description: Notion read/write via a maintained community fork of the official Notion MCP server. Needs a Notion integration token.

secret_prompts.label: Notion integration token
secret_prompts.help_text: Create a Notion integration, copy its secret, share specific pages with the integration so the MCP server can see them.

templates.validation_notes: Pinned to @mieubrisse/notion-mcp-server@2.1.2 — explicitly described as a maintained fork of the official server. Verify with [Test] before pilot rollout.

templates.label: Figma
templates.description: Read Figma files / inspect frames via a community Claude-Desktop-oriented MCP. Needs a Figma personal access token.

secret_prompts.label: Figma personal access token
secret_prompts.help_text: Settings → Personal access tokens. Read scope is enough for inspection-only agents.

templates.validation_notes: Pinned to claude-talk-to-figma-mcp@1.0.0. Community package — verify with [Test] before pilot rollout.

templates.label: Custom HTTP gateway
templates.description: Connects to your company's HTTP MCP gateway behind a VPN. Use this when you have ONE gateway aggregating multiple tool sources for the whole company.

secret_prompts.label: Bearer token
secret_prompts.help_text: Seat-specific token from your gateway. The gateway holds the actual upstream credentials, not dialekt.

templates.validation_notes: Generic template — pilots fill in their own gateway URL.
